Who We Are

We are a team that builds trust through quality

We are QA engineers, educators, and system thinkers who care deeply about how products work in the real world.

We started by teaching testing, grew into a strong professional community, and now help companies make quality a competitive advantage.

“People are our core value.”

Our Journey

From humble beginnings to industry leaders

Started as Educators

We began by teaching people software testing fundamentals. Not just theory, but real-world practices. We upgraded levels from middle to senior, not just beginners.

“Teaching others forced us to master quality ourselves.”

Built a Learning Community

Engineers started coming together to share knowledge, discuss failures, and learn from each other's experiences.

From Teaching to Practicing

Our deep understanding of quality principles naturally evolved into providing QA services to real products.

Learning from the Best

We studied practices from Google, Amazon, Netflix, and other tech giants. Not to copy, but to understand and adapt.

People-First Approach

We realized that quality is built by people, not just processes. People became our core value.

Pain-Driven Innovation

Client challenges pushed us to create better solutions. Their pain points became our innovation fuel.

Creating New Standards

We stopped following trends and started setting them. Defining what “new normal” means in QA.
